sentences.text: Zhouornis is a bird belonging to the family Bohaiornithidae, which sits within the larger, unranked group Enantiornithes.
Zhang Zihui, Luis María Chiappe, Gang Han, and Anusuya Chinsamy first named the genus in 2013 based on fossils from the Jehol Group in western Liaoning Province, northeastern China.
This creature lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Early Cretaceous period, specifically in the Aptian stage.
